organic_growth.rate_effect_note: COVID hit Q4 (Q4 organic -8.4%). Acquisition/FX net -0.1pt (workday adj.).
Release reconciliation: workday-adjusted +0.1%, acquisitions/divestitures/FX net +0.1% -> organic 0.2% (twelve months). Q4-21 organic 11.5% (URFS 13.7%, FA&S -6.8%).
10-K: 'increased organically by 10.2% as a result of increased sales volume'. FA&S organic 5.1%; 'Other revenue' (FA&S + All Other) organic 14.9%. URFS organic not captured.
By segment: URFS 10.8%, First Aid & Safety 13.1%. Quarterly: 13.9/12.8/11.8/10.3%.
Workday-adjusted +8.4% (one extra workday), acquisitions & FX net -0.4pt -> organic 8.0%.
Two fewer workdays; workday-adjusted +8.6%, acquisitions & FX net -0.6pt.

Revenue $11.26bn. 'Increased organically by 8.3% primarily as a result of increased sales volume'. By segment: URFS 7.6% (acq +0.4, FX +0.1; revenue $8,621.6m), First Aid & Safety 14.0% (acq +0.3). Fire Protection organic not captured for FY.

latest_interim.note: Revenue $3.01bn +10.9%; workday-adjusted +9.2%, acquisitions & FX net -0.3pt -> organic 8.9%. Segment organic (call): URFS 8.0%, First Aid & Safety 14.2%, Fire Protection 9.2%, Uniform Direct Sale 9.6%. Gross margin 51.5% record. Pricing 'consistent with prior years' (no number). FY2027 guidance raised to revenue $12.15-12.27bn (+7.9-8.9%) from $12.10-12.25bn; adj. EPS $5.45-5.54 (TARGET); guidance excludes UniFirst.

geography.note: 10-K FY2026 Item 7A: 'Foreign denominated revenue and operating income represents less than 10% of Cintas' consolidated revenue and operating income' -> US >90% (INFERENCE from FACT). Operations in US and Canada (call references; Latin America presence per qual not re-verified). No Europe/UK/China operations. Exact split not disclosed in text read.

claim_checks.finding: 10-K FY2026: commitment letter 10-Mar-2026 for a 364-day senior unsecured bridge facility of $2.85bn (two tranches); $5.2m bridge fees prepaid in FY26; CFO (Q1 FY27 call): ~$6m bridge fees over ~18 months, ~$4m expensed in FY27. Deal terms ($155 cash + 0.7720 CTAS shares per UNF share; ~$5.5bn) and ~1.5x net leverage at close are from the 11-Mar-2026 announcement (qual S3) - leverage figure not re-verified in this pass.

8-K 6-Oct-2026: FTC Second Request received 11-Jun-2026; both parties certified substantial compliance 2-Oct-2026 and entered a timing agreement not to close before 11-Dec-2026 absent FTC closing notice. Canadian Competition Bureau SIR (2-Jul-2026) response certified complete 29-Sep-2026. Cintas 'continues to expect' close before end of calendar 2026. Management declined further comment on Q1 call. Press reports of FTC staff concerns (qual) not verified from primary source.
Both confirmed. FY2026 (not in qual) organic 8.3%, reported +8.9%.
10-K FY22/FY23/FY26 attribute organic growth primarily to 'increased sales volume'; no numeric price split disclosed.
